# `kaolin/ops/conversions/PointsToMesh.js`

> **Source:** `engine/kaolin/ops/conversions/PointsToMesh.js`

PointsToMesh.js — Surface reconstruction from point clouds Converts unstructured 3D point sets into triangle meshes. Approaches: 1. Ball-Pivoting Algorithm (BPA) — requires oriented normals 2. Poisson Surface Reconstruction (simplified) — smooth, gap-filling 3. Alpha Shapes — convex hull variant with concavity control Compatible with: - MeshToPoints.js output (round-trip) - Particle system readback positions - LiDAR / scan data

## Functions

### `ballPivoting(points, normals, radius, options = {})`

Ball-Pivoting Algorithm for surface reconstruction. Rolls a ball of given radius over the point cloud; when it touches exactly 3 points it creates a triangle. Requires oriented normals for consistent triangle winding.

**Parameters:**

- `points` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3
- `normals` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3 (oriented outward)
- `radius` *(number)* — — ball radius
- `options` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `options.maxTriangles` *(number)* — — hard cap (default 200000)

**Returns:** }

### `alphaShape(points, alpha)`

Alpha-shape surface reconstruction. Computes 3D Delaunay tetrahedralization, then removes tetrahedra whose circumradius exceeds 1/alpha. Extracts boundary triangles.

**Parameters:**

- `points` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3
- `alpha` *(number)* — — controls concavity (larger = more convex)

**Returns:** }

### `convexHull(points)`

Convex hull of a 3D point set. Uses incremental algorithm. For large sets, prefer GPUConvexHull.js.

**Parameters:**

- `points` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3

**Returns:** }
